location_description: Springfield is the capital of the U.S. state of Illinois and the county seat and largest city of Sangamon County. The city's population was 116,250 at the 2010 U.S. Census, which makes it the state's sixth most-populous city, the second largest outside of the Chicago metropolitan area (after Rockford), and the largest in central Illinois. As of the 2020 census, the city's population was 114,394 with approximately 208,000 residents living in the Springfield metropolitan area.Springfield was settled by European-Americans in the late 1810s, around the time Illinois became a state.
